close_reason: Landed in b091273. Option 1 per bead: extracted build_* / assert_*_fixture helpers from benches/mime_pipeline.rs into tests/common/mod.rs. New tests/bench_fixtures.rs (3 #[test] items) exercises the structural invariants under cargo test. The bench file consumes the same module via #[path = "../tests/common/mod.rs"]. Bench-time asserts retained as belt-and-suspenders. The misleading 'equivalent guarantee' doc comment in the bench file was rewritten to describe the actual two-layer guarantee. JMAP-t307.5 (which depends on this doc-comment fix) can now close as already-done; will verify and close in a separate step. Pre-commit gate: 24 tests pass (20 unit + 3 bench_fixtures + 1 doc-test); clippy --all-targets clean; bench still compiles.
description:
Trigger: a workspace dep upgrade or refactor changes mime-tree's parse output shape, breaking build_medium_multipart or build_large_deep_multipart's structural invariants (child count, nesting depth, byte band).

Consequence: crate-jmap-mime/benches/mime_pipeline.rs lines 198-253 (assert_small_fixture, assert_medium_fixture, assert_large_fixture) only fire when bench_* functions actually run, i.e. under 'cargo bench -p jmap-mime'. The workspace pre-commit gate is 'cargo fmt + cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings + cargo test --workspace' per workspace AGENTS.md. cargo bench is not in that gate. So a fixture regression slips through CI silently and only surfaces when someone runs benches manually — possibly months later.

The docstring on lines 199-202 explicitly justifies the inline-assertion approach by saying '#[test] items inside this file would never be collected; inline assertions are the equivalent guarantee.' That justification is wrong: bench-time assertions are NOT equivalent to test-time assertions, because cargo test does not invoke them.

Fix options:
1. Add a sibling tests/bench_fixtures.rs that calls build_small_plain / build_medium_multipart / build_large_deep_multipart and the three assert_*_fixture helpers as #[test]s. The helpers would need to be moved to a shared module (mod common) accessible to both.
2. Or move the fixture builders into a tests/common/ helper crate-internal module imported by both the bench and a new fixtures test file.
3. Or accept the gap and document it explicitly — but then drop the misleading 'equivalent guarantee' claim from the bench file's doc comment.

Recommendation: option 1. Small file, no API change, restores the CI guarantee that was claimed.
title: Bench fixture invariants only run under cargo bench, not pre-commit gate
